dialect.detail: Spanish-language COBOL subprogram, likely from a Latin American mainframe or mid-range environment. Part of an ASDA (static analysis / standards checker) toolset. No vendor-specific extensions visible beyond GOBACK and COPY with .CPY extension.

purpose.domain_detail: COBOL source code static analysis / standards checker. This subprogram scans lines of COBOL text looking for the reserved word ' TO ' and verifies it appears at the correct column position (column 48) per coding standards.
purpose.summary: This subprogram (RASDA010) is part of a COBOL static analysis tool (ASDA). It iterates over lines of COBOL source text passed via a linkage area, searches for the reserved word ' TO ', and flags occurrences where ' TO ' does not appear at the expected column position (48), recording error details (line, column, error number) in the shared communication area.

notable_features: COPY CASDACOM.CPY for shared communication area
High comment ratio (48%) with Spanish-language comments
verdict.notes: Program is part of a larger ASDA (Analizador de Sintaxis / static analysis) suite. The COPY member CASDACOM.CPY defines ASDA-AREA and related fields not visible here. Spanish-language comments and author name suggest Latin American origin (Argentina likely given 'MATIAS CARBONEL'). Dialect family is uncertain as no IBM-specific or GnuCOBOL-specific extensions are visible.
